data.one_liner: Load and control GIF and APNG images with adjustable frame rates.
data.what_it_does: Provides custom widgets and controllers to render, play, pause, seek, and loop GIF or APNG animations from assets, network, memory, or files. Includes pre-fetching and caching support.
use_when: You need to display and control playback of animated GIFs or APNGs.
You want to set custom frame rates for animated images.
You need to pre-fetch and cache animated images.
avoid_when: You only need standard static image rendering without animation controls.
strengths: Supports loading from multiple sources (assets, network, memory, file).
Allows frame rate configuration and playback control via a controller.
Includes built-in pre-fetching and custom cache provider support.
weaknesses: Limited to GIF and APNG formats rather than generalized vector/Lottie animations.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need core image decoding and manipulation utilities rather than a UI widget.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your primary requirement is advanced network image caching rather than GIF playback control.
